title: Formalization of norm-variation of multiple ergodic averages for commuting transformations
summary: This is a Lean 4 formalization of norm-variation of multiple ergodic averages for commuting transformations, including Tao's norm-convergence theorem. At the heart of the argument is an explicit real-variable estimate for twisted multilinear averages. This formalization is based on the blueprint available at arXiv:2608.27321. The statements of the main theorems have been hand-formalized, while the proof was autoformalized during a one-week period using coding agents under human supervision.
